Game Overview

In Dead Road, the core idea is straightforward: face relentless foes on a dark highway in Dead Road. Tap to detonate incoming rockets while racing against time. With simple controls and increasing intensity, this adrenaline-packed arcade adventure will test your reflexes and decision-making skills. Enjoy breathtaking visuals, endless challenges, and stay focused for survival!
